concepts.title: e-business: Scope and Difference from Traditional Business
concepts.definition: e-business is the conduct of industry, trade and commerce using computer networks, covering e-purchasing, e-selling, e-production, e-finance, e-marketing and e-communication, and it differs from traditional business in ease of formation, cost, speed and global reach.
concepts.key_idea: e-business narrows the world into a click away, lowers transaction cost, and works round the clock, though personal touch is missing and technology requirements are high.

concepts.title: Online Transaction and Payment Mechanism
concepts.definition: An online transaction proceeds through three stages of registration, placing an order and payment, where payment uses cash on delivery, cheque, net banking transfer, or credit and debit cards secured by encryption using SSL technology.
concepts.key_idea: Registration needs a shopping cart to collect items, and card details travel in encrypted form so that unauthorised persons cannot read them.

solution_steps.explain: Order registration, order placement and payment in sequence.

concepts.title: Security Concerns of e-business and Operating Resources
concepts.definition: e-business faces transaction risks of default and electronic payment problems, data storage risks from viruses and hacking, and risks of intrusion through copied or altered websites, requiring safeguards like passwords, encryption and cyber security measures.
concepts.key_idea: Outsourcing of information services and the choice between payment gateways and off the shelf shopping software are key operating requirements of e-business.

solution_steps.explain: Separate transaction risk, data risk and intrusion risk.

concepts.title: Outsourcing: Concept, Scope and BPO KPO Services
concepts.definition: Outsourcing is contracting out selected business processes to outside agencies so the firm can concentrate on core competence, and its scope covers production outsourcing, and business process outsourcing in finance, customer care and IT enabled services, including knowledge process outsourcing requiring specialised knowledge.
concepts.key_idea: BPO and KPO services like call centres, payroll and legal research have made India a favoured outsourcing destination because of skilled manpower and low cost advantage.
